signal: CGTech released VERICUT 9.6 in June 2025 with new AI tools (Vericut Assistant and Vericut Intelligence) and is debuting Composites Applications updates

email.body1:
Justin, saw CGTech shipped VERICUT 9.6 with the new AI tools and fresh composites capabilities.

A major release like that usually opens more accounts in the composites and aerospace space than a technical sales team can personally work, and that is where good-fit shops slip through. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for CGTech off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to fill the composites pipeline
email.body2:
Justin, quick follow-up for CGTech.

With 9.6 out, the list of manufacturers worth a conversation grows faster than a technical sales team can call them. Most teams can't say precisely how many meetings they need to hit target, so the coverage gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings CGTech needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Justin, last bit of proof for CGTech.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire reps fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how CGTech's reply rate likely compares to similar technical software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Justin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling composites pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Post-release cycles are their own kind of busy, and timing matters here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a technical sales motion? I'll tailor it to CGTech either way.
